milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The soul_torch is at spawn-relative (6, 0, 6), which is ~8.5 blocks from spawn. max_distance=5 ensures the player must actually navigate toward the soul_torch (walking at least ~3.5 blocks from spawn) rather than satisfying the milestone by simply looking in the right direction from the starting position. facing_tolerance=60 confirms the player is oriented toward the blue flame.

Uses inventory_has because mining a fletching_table in survival mode drops the block as an item into the player's inventory. The player starts with an empty inventory and no fletching_table, so having min_count=1 confirms the block was successfully broken and collected. No special tool is required — fletching_table can be mined by hand.
